name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.download.SpeechVoiceDownloadLandingCardActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an app-download ad selects the card landing design. It shows the advertised app's download offer in a card layout.
disableEffect: The card-style app-download landing page will no longer open.
